Treating this as durable Discussion-writing constraints for the B1 learn path. Checking what is already in `learnt/` and the Friction procedure so we only surface what still needs your decision.## Acknowledged — already locked (no Discussion rewrite)

Your constraints match material already on this run. Nothing new needs writing into `learnt/` unless you want a merge/rewrite.

| Your constraint | Where it lives | Status |
|-----------------|----------------|--------|
| Academic prose; no path cites (e.g. `observationData.md`) | `CTX-DISCUSSION-NO-PATH-STYLE-CITES` | Appended |
| Discussion: high-level pattern only; no RAT group ratios / findings dump | `CTX-DISCUSSION-NO-RESTATE-RESULTS` | Appended |
| RAT as light frame; do not re-teach (Methods already has it) | `CTX-DISCUSSION-NO-REINTRODUCE-METHODS-FRAMES` | Appended |
| No extreme labels (e.g. “a false hierarchy”) | `CTX-DISCUSSION-NO-EXTREME-EVALUATIVE-PHRASING` | Appended |
| **Real friction** = Pattern P under Theory 1 vs Prediction/understanding U from Theory 2 (with bridge + explicit clash) | Skill `move-model.md` Friction procedure | **Skip as `learnt/`** (procedure SoT); already the B1 gate |

Friction is **not** “the old frame is incomplete / a false hierarchy.” It is: observation framed by Theory 1 → Pattern P; Theory 2 → bridge → U; prose names how P and U partially conflict.

**B1 already uses that structure:** Theory 1 = RAT (Hughes et al., 2006); Theory 2 = TPACK (Mishra & Koehler, 2006); U ≈ IST ≥ PST on sophisticated / non-replacement use; clash = reverse surface ordering under RAT. Locked ¶1 is high-level, no ratios, no path cites, no “false hierarchy.”

---

## Still open (learn fallback → `PERSIST_OK`)

Craft steers **m1–m3** (declarative voice; name model once; front-load tension) remain **not contexts**. Choose one:

1. **rubric append** — store as project rubrics  
2. **skill-steer only** — keep as unit/skill steers only  
3. **skip** — do not persist  

After that, send **`PERSIST_OK`**. Then low-scaffold **reflect** → **`REFLECT_OK`**, then B2.
